h1b.say: Because neither is singing, traveler. Both are RECITING. The corn from its wiring, we from our fathers. Same source.

h1.say: You carry the humming grain. Sit by the south geyser — listen. Your corn and our hymn... they hum the SAME line.

options.label: Why
options.text: Why would corn know your scripture?

h5.say: Write it down, traveler: the world keeps minutes of its own birth. Whatever opens with such a key... it was built to be opened.

h2.say: We transcribed the south hymn against your grain's hum. Line lengths. Repeated headers. Timestamps, traveler. Our holiest hymn is a record of the world starting up. Generations chanted a boot log phonetically and called the warmth it gave them faith.

options.label: Gentle
options.text: It still gave warmth. That part was real.

options.label: Hollow
options.text: So your faith is a transcription error.

h1x.say: Then let the grain answer for itself, traveler.
